newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Switches in EIB.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Switches in EIB.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' latest trade recommendations focused on lire, dollars, sterling, marks and yen. Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY Over the last month the EIB 7.45 percent has

outperformed the EIB 10.80 pct by 30 basis points in price terms. EIB 7.45 percent has remained expensive against the swap for the past month, trading around 27 b.p. through on the bid side. EIB 10.80 percent is attractive as it offers around a 13 b.p. pick up in yield and is cheap against the swap and the BTP (trading respectively at around 13 and 17 b.p. through).
STRATEGY EIB 6.20 pct is the only supranational in the

2002 area that is trading below par. However, due to the interest it has received it has become particularly expensive against the swap at around minus 43 b.p. on the bid side. EIB 11.25 pct has become cheap (at around three b.p. through the swap) and offers a good pick up in yield of around 45 b.p.
STRATEGY Over the past month World Bank has outperformed

the DSL by 30 b.p. in price terms. World Bank is expensive against the swap, at around 28 b.p. through and the BTP, at around 40 b.p. through. DSL is only four months longer in maturity and represents around a 28 b.p. pick up in yield and is cheap against the swap at around only four b.p. through.
STRATEGY Credit Local 06 over the past month has

underperformed the Credit Local 07 by approximately 70 b.p. in price terms. It is cheap against the swap (trading at around four b.p. through) and offers around a 17 b.p. pick up in yield for a shorter duration.
STRATEGY This credit improving, duration neutral trade
can currently be done for a yield pick-up of around 30 b.p. and takes out over 60 cents in cash.
STRATEGY This ratings neutral trade can currently be
done for a yield pick-up of around 11 b.p. (or plus 15 b.p. against the curve). It allows investors to shorten duration by 0.3 year and also takeout over 60 cents in cash.

An alternative is to switch the IADB into the World Bank 6.375 pct. This credit neutral trade currently offers a yield pick-up of around 32 b.p., beating the curve by around 21 b.p. and also takes out two points in cash.
STRATEGY The EIB is currently at around minus 11 b.p. to

the Gilt, whereas the Chubu Electric Power is being offered at around plus 25 b.p. and therefore is much cheaper. The EIB is looking too expensive against the Chubu even if it is a good name. Both bonds are triple-A rated, however the EIB attracts more of a premium.
STRATEGY This switch offers a yield pick-up of around

130 b.p. The long end of the yen curve is attracting interest from investors who have an appetite for the higher returns in relation to shorter-dated maturities. The steep curve means that there is a wide cost of carry between longer-dated bonds and money market rates. Last July, the same trade would have resulted in a smaller yield gain of 79 b.p. The present level is only seven b.p. away from the one-year high.
STRATEGY The five-year sector has been the strongest
area of the Euroyen curve lately and, contrary to the rest of the curve, is looking relatively expensive to swaps. Yamaichi was looking for this to reverse.
STRATEGY The Pfandbrief market has recently outperformed

the Bund market which is unusual as the Pfandbrief market tends to lag. Due to this, and the improved liquidity, there has been increased international demand for Pfandbriefs. RHEINHYP is a triple-AAA rated jumbo Pfandbrief.
